QuestInfo.0: Now that you've heard Claire's story, you're going to need to make some plans. This place is dangerous!
QuestInfo.1: Now that you've heard Claire's story, you're going to need to make some plans. This place is dangerous! You looked around the area, and found a big pack of Lupos. Hunt some down to make an escape route.
QuestInfo.2: Now that you've heard Claire's story, you're going to need to make some plans. This place is dangerous! You cleared out some of the Lupos, but found Leon making a big fuss. What's he on about now?

0.0: I understand the circumstances Miss Tremier is in. Vaughn has his reasons as well, I'm sure. Either way, we're out of time.
0.1: This isn't a very safe spot to stop. San Commerci's a safe city, but there are packs of wild wolves out here in the outskirts.
0.2: Miss Tremier's safety is our primary concern. #h0#, maybe you'd be kind enough to stick around and deal with any wolves that show up?
